annotations.text:
KAN-5 — photograph a receipt (slice 2/4).
Every state the ticket names has an artboard. Numbers run in flow order; the ticket comment maps each acceptance criterion to an artboard.

Visual language follows the owner-set aesthetic direction: one typeface doing the hierarchy, neutral base, one accent spent only on progress and interactive text, two corner radii, flat surfaces.

03 is our own screen, shown before the system prompt. The system camera prompt itself is never drawn or imitated — tapping Allow camera hands off to the OS.

04 is the only route back once access is off: Settings, or back to the list.

Getting the upload address and sending the photo are two network calls, but one bar. It never resets, never restarts, never goes backwards — the user sees a single save.

This is the one place the accent fills a shape: it reports state, so it earns the colour.

No error is a dead end. 09 keeps the photo on the device and offers Try again plus a way back. 10 cannot be retried with the same photo, so it offers a fresh one instead.

An expired upload address and a photo the server cannot find both surface as 09 — the user cannot act on the difference.
The entry row is the piece KAN-6 edits. Its geometry is fixed here so extraction changes the words, not the layout — no reflow when a receipt is read.
